learnings: By family, median Sharpe 2007-18 → 2020-23 → 2024-25: Mean reversion + trend long-term +0.06 → +0.33 → +1.89; Pullback in trend long-term +0.12 → +0.12 → +1.89; Pullback in trend short-term +0.11 → +0.42 → +0.98; Crossover + trend short-term +0.27 → -0.41 → +0.42; Crossover + trend long-term +0.34 → -0.16 → +0.25; Divergence short-term -0.28 → -0.27 → +0.23; Mean reversion short-term -0.27 → -0.19 → +0.02; Breakout long-term +0.06 → +0.67 → +0.02; Crossover long-term -0.03 → -0.18 → -0.29; Mean reversion long-term -0.14 → -0.18 → -0.37; Breakout short-term +0.01 → +0.02 → -0.39; Crossover short-term -0.09 → -0.18 → -0.49; Divergence long-term -0.35 → -0.95 → -0.52; Mean reversion + trend short-term -0.04 → +0.46 → -0.65.
Mean reversion (long): median Sharpe -0.07, win rate 47%, edge -0.56% per trade, 28% of tests positive, 10% robust.
Pullback in trend (long): median Sharpe 0.14, win rate 52%, edge +0.26% per trade, 85% of tests positive, 50% robust.
Crossover (long): median Sharpe 0.03, win rate 47%, edge -0.17% per trade, 54% of tests positive, 17% robust.
Divergence (long): median Sharpe -0.11, win rate 44%, edge -0.52% per trade, 25% of tests positive, 0% robust.
Breakout (long): median Sharpe 0.21, win rate 52%, edge +0.14% per trade, 100% of tests positive, 62% robust.

After a close 3% below the 9-day MA (193 cases): touches the (falling) 9-day MA within 20 days in 96% of cases (median 6 days) but gets back to the 9-day MA level of the signal day only 48% of the time; average drawdown before that -3.9% (worst -23%), return after 10 days -0.29% (up 51% of the time).

After a close 5% below the 9-day MA (74 cases): touches the (falling) 9-day MA within 20 days in 95% of cases (median 8 days) but gets back to the 9-day MA level of the signal day only 42% of the time; average drawdown before that -5.5% (worst -22%), return after 10 days -0.89% (up 42% of the time).

After a close 7% below the 9-day MA (35 cases): touches the (falling) 9-day MA within 20 days in 91% of cases (median 9 days) but gets back to the 9-day MA level of the signal day only 31% of the time; average drawdown before that -6.8% (worst -19%), return after 10 days -0.73% (up 40% of the time).
First dip to the 9-day MA in an uptrend (159 cases): new 20-day high within 20 days 53%, closed below the 50-day 68%, average dip -4.4%, return after 20 days +1.31% (up 52%).
First dip to the 20-day MA in an uptrend (119 cases): new 20-day high within 20 days 47%, closed below the 50-day 73%, average dip -4.2%, return after 20 days +1.00% (up 52%).
First dip to the 50-day MA in an uptrend (68 cases): new 20-day high within 20 days 38%, closed below the 50-day 97%, average dip -5.0%, return after 20 days +0.54% (up 49%).
229 rule x market x holding-period tests: a t-stat around 3.3 is what the luckiest test would show by chance, so prefer rules that work across many markets and in both 2007-18 and 2019+.
